sourceDesignIssue: “pod rooms and discovery” leaves discovery as an abstract noun without naming what is discovered. The pinned Pod UI identifies a pod discovery index and discovered pods, so wording “discover other Pods” is clearer and supports consistent translations. This is a terminology clarification recommendation, not a source edit.
